rmys-02-c1.text: Decree of the Senate on the Bacchanalia. Droit romain, Universite Grenoble Alpes.
rmys-02-c1.quote: No one in a company of more than five persons altogether, men and women, shall perform such rites ; nor in that company shall more than two men or three women be present
